name: CCD Calibration Pipeline with Real Palomar LFC Data
description: Using real CCD data from the Palomar 200-inch Hale Telescope Large Format Camera (LFC), perform a complete image calibration pipeline in AstroImageJ. The raw frames are organized in ~/AstroImages/calibration_project/ with subdirectories for bias, dark, flat, and science frames. Create a master bias (median-combine the bias frames), a master dark (median-combine the dark frames and subtract the master bias), and a master flat (median-combine the flat frames, subtract the master bias, and normalize). Then calibrate each science frame by subtracting the master bias and scaled master dark, and dividing by the normalized master flat. Save all master frames and calibrated science images to the 'reduced/' subdirectory. Login credentials: username 'ga', password 'password123'.

metadata.data_source: Palomar 200-inch Hale Telescope, Large Format Camera (LFC)
metadata.data_description: Cryo-cooled CCD frames from the Astropy CCD Reduction Guide dataset
